text.tspan: Building a circuit on a breadboard comes
with its challenges, such as parasitic capacitances. But for
smaller analog signals, this can be a crucial step, since
validation is easier than on an integrated circuit! A
breadboard makes it easy to measure all voltage points
the stages. The stages by themselves worked, but when
cascading them, the output would deviate from the
expected result. I learnt that this is due to the loading
effects of each stage not being ideal, and adjustments
Overall, this project was very successful,
